metadata.description: A working flow for Claude Code as versioned plugins: a personal knowledge wiki, session conventions, a prompt audit and a change walkthrough

plugins.name: brain
plugins.description: A personal knowledge wiki in plain markdown: save fixes and notes, recall them by topic or symptom, lint the vault, drain the inbox

plugins.name: session-discipline
plugins.description: Working-session conventions you adopt into your own CLAUDE.md, and a decision-interview skill (content arrives in a later release)

plugins.name: prompt-audit
plugins.description: Mine your own Claude Code prompt history for what you keep asking by hand, and turn it into rules (content arrives in a later release)

plugins.name: walkthrough
plugins.description: A guided test walkthrough of a branch, a pull request or a pasted diff (content arrives in a later release)
